title: You Swapped Places with a Billionaire, Part 4
premise: The former billionaire faces your parents’ evening and treats school like his company. Mum has one unexpected question about his expense claim. Viewers suggest what part of their own life would break him next.

scenes.anchor: You swapped bodies with a billionaire. He's at your parents' evening.
scenes.description: Open on the former billionaire in your young body, already facing a falling school report at parents’ evening.
scenes.label: billionaire-hook

scenes.anchor: You swapped bodies with a billionaire. He's at your parents' evening.
scenes.description: Pull back on He’s to reveal Mum beside the former billionaire. The report has landed and the situation is clear.
scenes.label: school-hook

scenes.anchor: Can I send my lawyer?
scenes.description: Young body tries to delegate parents’ evening to a lawyer.
scenes.label: lawyer

scenes.anchor: You can stay right there.
scenes.description: Mum’s firm seated stop gesture ends the escape attempt before seven seconds.
scenes.label: stay

scenes.anchor: He called group work an unpaid internship.
scenes.description: The teacher opens the report and explains the first employer-like complaint.
scenes.label: internship

scenes.anchor: I was developing talent.
scenes.description: A finite defensive open-palm gesture accompanies the young body’s business excuse.
scenes.label: talent

scenes.anchor: He made his partner do all the work.
scenes.description: A school project card allocates all the work to one partner.
scenes.label: partner

scenes.anchor: I offered him exposure.
scenes.description: Young body defends the unpaid arrangement.
scenes.label: exposure

scenes.anchor: Sounds familiar. He calls pocket money a salary.
scenes.description: Mum recognises an ordinary family habit rather than the body swap.
scenes.label: familiar

scenes.anchor: Sounds familiar. He calls pocket money a salary.
scenes.description: Four pocket-money coins land as Mum recalls his new salary vocabulary.
scenes.label: salary

scenes.anchor: Then he tried to fire the sports teacher.
scenes.description: Teacher reads the sports-teacher complaint from the report.
scenes.label: fire

scenes.anchor: Why?
scenes.description: Mum asks for a reason, with open questioning eyes.
scenes.label: why

scenes.anchor: Poor performance.
scenes.description: Young body blames the teacher’s performance.
scenes.label: performance

scenes.anchor: You came last. In your own team.
scenes.description: Mum starts correcting him.
scenes.label: last

scenes.anchor: You came last. In your own team.
scenes.description: A results card places his avatar last in his own team.
scenes.label: result

scenes.anchor: Exactly.
scenes.description: He accepts the evidence as proof of his own excuse.
scenes.label: exactly

scenes.anchor: And after I took his phone, he asked to speak to my manager.
scenes.description: Teacher introduces the confiscated-phone complaint.
scenes.label: manager

scenes.anchor: And after I took his phone, he asked to speak to my manager.
scenes.description: The report becomes a simple headteacher contact screen on the manager line.
scenes.label: manager-phone

scenes.anchor: Standard procedure.
scenes.description: Young body treats the complaint as standard business practice.
scenes.label: procedure

scenes.anchor: Finally, he tried to expense the school trip.
scenes.description: Teacher introduces the final school-trip complaint with the expense still hidden.
scenes.label: trip

scenes.anchor: Finally, he tried to expense the school trip.
scenes.description: The report’s receipt turns toward us, revealing a fictional £45 expense claim.
scenes.label: expense

scenes.anchor: Did it work?
scenes.description: Mum leans forward with genuine hope: Did it work?
scenes.label: worked

scenes.anchor: Did it work?
scenes.description: Teacher is surprised and the young body is caught out. Let both reactions settle.
scenes.label: reaction

scenes.anchor: What part of your life would break this billionaire?
scenes.description: The former billionaire gestures toward the viewer while their question builds in a clear comment bubble above him.
scenes.label: cta
